title: Degree-zero mapping adjunction for the prescribed limit
statement: For the same normalized DVR tower, coherent finite identifications, and integral limit presentation as lem-coef-integral-dualizing-mapping-limit, every constructible K has the displayed Hom equivalence from `K.obj ⟶ M.obj` to the coefficient-point Hom from the compact-support tower into the coefficient-unit object.
